description_en: Retrieves a list of task orders
kebab_example: aliyun support-plan list-dd-task-order --open-group-id DAWNN14N --task-status '处理中' --create-real-name '云小宝' --start-time 2024-08-01_14:09:11 --end-time 2024-08-20_14:09:16 --page-size 10 --page-no 1 --is-urgent true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDdTaskOrder

parameters.help_en: The ID of the enterprise service group. You can obtain this ID from the development access section of the enterprise service desk. This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 企业服务群ID，可在企业服务台开发接入处获取，必填项
parameters.name: open_group_id

parameters.help_en: The status of the task order
parameters.name: task_status

parameters.help_en: The start time used to filter task orders by creation time
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，用于筛选任务单创建时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time used to filter task orders by creation time
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，用于筛选任务单创建时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页参数，每页查询数量，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the task order is urgent
parameters.name: is_urgent
